description: Show a purchase proof and trace it: purchase → catch → storage temperature. Use this when the customer asks to see what they bought, where it was caught or how it was stored. Pass the customerKey from this conversation, or a purchase ID (PB-…). Read-only; returns only stamped (on-chain) proofs, with the arguments for verify_catch and verify_temp.

customerKey.description: Your customerKey (gyotak_cus_...). Omit when connected through a personal token URL.

purchaseId.description: Purchase ID (PB-YYYYMMDD-xxxxxxxx). Takes precedence over customerKey.

name: verify_purchase
title: Purchase proof and trace
